## 💡 Feature Proposal
A clear and concise description of what the feature, new service offering, or enhancement is.

## 🎯 Problem It Solves
Is your feature request related to a problem or competitor advantage? (e.g. *“Customers frequently ask for smart TV mounting or mesh Wi-Fi installation…”*)

## 🛠️ Proposed Solution
Describe how you envision this working from a user and technical perspective.

## 🌟 Alternatives Considered
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## ℹ️ Additional Context
Add any other context, mockups, or references here.
